name: decision-tree-agent
description: A rule-based decision tree agent that evaluates prioritized condition-action rules against a context object and executes the highest-priority matching action.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a lightweight, rule-driven dispatch system: route requests, apply business logic, or orchestrate actions based on runtime context without a full workflow engine. Rules have numeric priorities and are evaluated highest-first; the first matching rule wins in evaluate(), while evaluateAll() runs every matching rule. Ideal for chatbot intent routing, feature-flag gating, alert triage, or any scenario where multiple named conditions must be checked in a defined order.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique identifier for a Rule instance.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Synchronous function (ctx) => boolean | truthy — determines whether this rule matches the current context.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Async function (ctx) => result — executed when the rule matches; the return value is surfaced in the evaluate/evaluateAll result.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Numeric priority for the rule (default 0). Higher values are evaluated before lower values.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Human-readable description of the rule's intent (default empty string).

parameters.name: onMatch
parameters.description: DecisionTreeAgent constructor callback — called with { rule, result, ctx } after a successful rule action.

parameters.name: onNoMatch
parameters.description: DecisionTreeAgent constructor callback — called with ctx when no rule matches.
